cases.name: payload columns are appended to the key
cases.query: SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = ?

ddl: -- MySQL has no INCLUDE; payload columns are appended to the key so the index covers the query.

cases.name: backticks, schema-qualified table, range
cases.query: SELECT `o`.`total` FROM `shop`.`orders` AS o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= ? ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

ddl: -- MySQL has no INCLUDE; payload columns are appended to the key so the index covers the query.

cases.name: leading wildcard
cases.query: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%son'

cases.name: DATE() on the column is non-sargable
cases.query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = '2024-01-01'

cases.name: join
cases.query: SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'ID'

cases.name: TEXT columns cannot be appended; the PK rides along implicitly
cases.query: SELECT id, total, note FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

ddl: -- MySQL has no INCLUDE; payload columns are appended to the key so the index covers the query.
-- Not covered: note (TEXT/BLOB/JSON columns need a prefix length to be indexed).

cases.name: InnoDB clustered primary key covers lookups by id
cases.query: SELECT total FROM orders WHERE id = ?

cases.name: secondary index covers the PK column implicitly
cases.query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE customer_id = ?
